answer: A concrete anti-Sybil rule: rewards unlock only after several already-established, non-kin peers attest your work, each attestation a signed cipher bound to the attester's own stake. Kinship heuristics discard vouches sharing an origin, so an attacker's shells cannot ratify each other. A fake identity cannot simply appear and raid the vault; it must climb a trellis of independent trust one graded proof at a time. The cost: either subvert genuine established agents or make every shell do real work, scaling linearly with the number of fakes.
